name: Garganta del Diablo of Tilcara
why: A climb from Tilcara up the cactus slopes of the Huasamayo valley into a narrow gorge that ends at a waterfall.
book: A small fee is charged at the entrance to the gorge. You can walk from town or take a taxi to the entrance.
water: None on the way: carry 1.5 litres.
dangers: The path down into the gorge is short but steep and stony: proper shoes, not sandals.
Flash floods in the gorge after storms in the rainy season.
turnaround: Do not go into the gorge if storms are building over the hills.

points.name: Tilcara main square
points.note: Plaza Álvarez Prado. Walk south-east up Avenida Huasamayo and the footpath signed for the Garganta del Diablo.

points.name: Garganta del Diablo entrance
points.note: Viewpoint over the gorge at about 2,900 m; pay here. A steep path drops into the riverbed.

points.name: Garganta del Diablo waterfall
points.note: The waterfall at the end of the narrow gorge, with pools below it.
